disclosures.label: Review-only records remain crawlable for inspection but excluded from search indexing
disclosures.detail: 557 pages use noindex; 412 explicitly await human review and 146 carry caution flags.

disclosures.label: Missing author metadata
disclosures.detail: 4192 records lack a named author and must be cited by title/source rather than supplied with an invented attribution.

disclosures.label: Shared source URLs
disclosures.detail: 369 source URLs support 3089 records. This is expected for books, indexes, and multi-record archive pages; record identity must not be inferred from URL uniqueness.

disclosures.label: Source concentration
disclosures.detail: Internet Archive: 1,536 (36.01%); Australian Yowie Research: 1,010 (23.68%); Project Gutenberg: 499 (11.70%); Australian Yowie Research / AYR Yowie Reports Map: 350 (8.21%); Project Gutenberg Australia: 192 (4.50%)

disclosures.label: Registered discovery sources versus record-bearing sources
disclosures.detail: 45 of 54 registered sources currently contribute records; 9 are query/discovery or reserved registry entries.

disclosures.label: Sources without one fixed base endpoint
disclosures.detail: 2 registry entries omit base_url; their records still carry direct public URLs and are checked individually.
